blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: A pointer is a variable that holds an address. `*p` follows the address to the value.

blocks.title: Pointer syntax
items: `*p` is the value at the address
`p + 1` moves by one item, not one byte

blocks.title: Swap through pointers
Arrays and pointers
items: A function gets only a pointer to the first item
Pass the length as another argument

blocks.title: Strings
items: A string ends with a 0 byte, `'\0'`
`char t[] = "hi"` is a copy you can change

blocks.body: Never dereference NULL or step outside an array. Both are undefined behavior and often crash.
